results.title: Gold per tola gains Rs800 in Pakistan
results.description: Gold prices in Pakistan increased on Monday in line with their gain in the international market. In the local market, gold price per tola reached Rs457,366 after a gain of Rs800 during the day. Similarly, 10-gram gold was sold at Rs392,091after it increased by Rs685 according to rates shared by the All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association (APGJSA). On Saturday , gold price per tola reached Rs456,536 after a gain of Rs2,200 during the day. The international rate of gold was up by $8 to reach $4,349 per ounce (with a premium of $20). Meanwhile, the price of silver increased by Rs77 to reach Rs6,903 per tola.

results.title: Iran, Oman reach new Hormuz security mechanisms
results.description: Iran and Oman are developing new mechanisms to monitor shipping safety through the Strait of Hormuz. Discussions between Tehran and Muscat are progressing smoothly and constructively on this matter. These mechanisms will cover shipping, environmental issues, maritime services, and crime combating. Iran states the Strait remains unsafe due to ongoing US violations and aggression. The full opening of the Strait depends on the resolution of broader military situations.

results.title: The Leela Mumbai Commemorates 79 Years of Independence with a Chef-Curated Buffet
results.description: There is a certain stillness that comes before remembrance; a moment where gratitude gathers before it finds words. As India completes 79 years of independence, The Leela Mumbai pauses to honour the freedom fighters whose sacrifices made this day possible, with a chef-curated buffet that carries the weight of that history forward. Anticipation builds not just in the flavours, but in what they represent; a nation built dish by dish, region by region, into something whole. Each course on the table has been curated with intent, a slow unfolding of India’s culinary heritage that mirrors the long road the country once walked toward freedom. Open to residents and non-residents alike, the occasion invites guests to arrive not just for a meal, but for a moment; one where celebration and reflection sit side by side. At Citrus, this Independence Day, the promise of the afternoon is felt long before the first course arrives, and lingers long after the last. Details: Date: 15th August 2026 Meal: Lunch Timings: 12:30 pm – 3:30 pm Venue: Citrus, The Leela Mumbai Price: ₹2,800+ tax per person
